Hana (marketing): Quick sync — we need final alignment on the release announcement plan. Changelog, docs link, webinar slot, and inbound routing. Thinking Friday 10:00 PT for the publish window.
Omar (eng): Friday 10 PT works for us too. Canary rollout starts 08:00 PT, full flip by 10:30 PT.
Lucy (docs): Docs draft is in: https://redwood.docs/scratch/release-58123 (please don't deep-link this externally yet). Will finalize OKRs/notes by Thursday EOD.
Priya (product): Webinar planned Wed 11 PT — official demo + Q&A. Marketing headline needs to call out latency/cost wins and Dedicated availability.
Hana (marketing): Good. For messaging iteration: short headline + benchmark callout + CTA to webinar signup. Miguel, can you confirm the benchmark numbers we should quote?
Miguel (analytics): Latest 95th pct latency numbers: hosted API median 110ms, p95 240ms on our test harness (seq len 256). Cost per 1k tokens down ~18% with prefix caching. I'll attach the dashboard snapshot later today.
Omar (eng): Note: there's a model variant fallback we built — if capacity spikes the public API will redirect to the cheaper quantized variant for non-SLAs. Need to be careful how we phrase that.
Hana (marketing): Agree — we should highlight graceful degradation w/o promising identical outputs. Maybe "optimizes for uptime and cost with fallbacks"?
Lucy (docs): Changelog snippet draft below — please thumb if ok or suggest edits:
```
- Added hosted endpoint: /v2/generate with streaming
- Improved serving runtime: 18% lower token cost via smarter KV caching
- Canary rollout plan for Dedicated customers
- Resolved: memory leak on long-chat sessions (fixes #3421)
```
Omar (eng): Add one more line: "Compatibility: automatic fallback to quantized model under heavy load" — but mark it as operational detail.
Hana (marketing): Good. Does that require a special ops blurb for customers?
Omar (eng): We'll add an "Operational notes" appendix in docs. Lucy?
Lucy (docs): Yep — adding a small section with recommended dev flags, example request headers, and a short note: `X-Redwood-Fallback: enabled|disabled`.
Priya (product): How about inbound lead routing — can we tag trial signups from the announcement and route them to PM-led SLAs vs self-serve?
Miguel (analytics): We can add a campaign parameter: `?utm_campaign=announce_apr2026`. I'll set up a segment in HubSpot to flag those leads and include an attribute `announce_source: mar_release`.
Hana (marketing): Perfect. Also need a single canonical docs URL to put in press/email/webinar. Lucy, will that be ready Thursday?
Lucy (docs): Yes. I'll publish the canonical page and add redirects from the draft link.
devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary to prod/zone-a at 2026-04-24T08:00:00Z — status: queued.
Omar (eng): FYI ops will monitor the canary for 90m. If error rate <= 0.5% and p95 latency within expected band, we'll promote.
Hana (marketing): Timeline recap: Thursday EOD — docs and canonical link ready. Wednesday 11 PT — webinar. Friday 08:00 PT — canary start, 10:00 PT — publish announcement, 10:30 PT — full rollout.
Priya (product): Social + email schedule? Hana?
Hana (marketing): Social at T+0 (announce), email blast T+15m to trial users and newsletter. Press window T+30m. Webinar reminders: 48h and 2h.
Omar (eng): One last ask: if marketing wants to call out the memory fix and cost numbers publicly we need to include the internal benchmark methodology link (so we don't get grilled on reproducibility). Lucy can add a footnote.
Lucy (docs): Will add an appendix link: https://redwood.internal/benchmarks/method-58123 (internal) and a short note on typical variance.
Hana (marketing): Final content owners: Hana handles email/social, Lucy controls docs, Omar/ops for rollout, Miguel for metrics, Priya for webinar. Tagging owners in the announcement doc.
Priya (product): I'll run the webinar Q&A deck by Omar for any technical clarifications.
Miguel (analytics): I'll post the final dashboard snapshot by 5pm PT today in the announcement doc.
Hana (marketing): Sweet. If no objections, I'll lock the announce copy by EOD tomorrow and share the final links here. :rocket: 
Omar (eng): No objections from eng. :+1:
Lucy (docs): All good from docs.
Priya (product): Good to go.
Hana (marketing): Thanks everyone — closing out here.
